nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Cảm xúc & ý kiến · bài tự soạn
kind: Tin nhắn thoại an ủi bạn trượt thi lái xe
L: Hey Tom, it's Hana. I heard about your driving test, and I'm so sorry.
I know you must be really down right now.
But don't beat yourself up. Lots of people fail the first time.
My cousin failed twice, and now he's the best driver in our family.
It's not the end of the world, okay?
Look on the bright side: you've already learned a lot.
If you practice a little more, you'll pass next time. I'm sure of it.
Let's get ice cream this weekend. I'm free on Saturday.
Hang in there, okay? You've got this!
